bioconda.name: gain-vep-annotator
bioconda.summary: GAIn plugin with annotators that run the Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor (VEP)
bioconda.description:
gain-vep-annotator adds two annotators to GAIn: vep_full_annotator, which
uses a local VEP cache, and vep_effect_annotator, which uses the reference
genome and gene models of a GAIn Genomic Resource Repository. VEP runs in
a Docker container.

commands: python -c "import importlib.metadata as m; v = m.version('gain-vep-annotator'); assert v == '2026.11.1', v"

python -c "from importlib.metadata import distribution as d; eps = [e for e in d('gain-vep-annotator').entry_points if e.group == 'console_scripts' or e.group.startswith('gain.')]; [e.load() for e in eps]; assert eps; print(len(eps), 'entry points loaded')"
